payload.text: ISSUE:0671, on hv's word relayed by vc (10:21Z by vc's date -u): an intentd started without CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR sees no Claude session, so the estate page marks every held slot ORPHANED. It is banked at refs/bank/cc/0671/fix-v1 (patch-id cb974be96777, tree 145113ed5b7f on fe748602e), in the shape vc approved. Intent.app passes the login shell's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR as it passes PATH. The at-login plist carries the caller's value or else the plist's own, so the boot heal never drops it, and start --at-login beside a running daemon adds it. cc's desk run, ask 01M6BBKENABGC65S1XAYRCWHD3 with script refs/bank/cc/0671/run-v1.sh, waits its place on devbin-vc's desk; vc's judge follows. The Swift mutant, tmp/wt-cc-0671-mutant, is never banked and goes after its red. It lands after the push of the three fixes, on vc's word naming HEAD.
